t: What Medical Supply Shortage Database Is All About
title: What Medical Supply Shortage Database Is All About
description: Drug and supply shortages are chronic: US hospitals routinely face 100+ active drug shortages (sterile injectables, generics with thin margins). Causes cluster: single-source manufacturing, quality failures, and just-in-time inventory. COVID's PPE crisis showed the cost. Mitigations that work: redundancy, stockpiles, substitution protocols, and domestic manufacturing capacity. This database is the complete supply shortage: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
